articles.summary: Universal Health Realty Income Trust (NYSE:UHT) announced today that for the three-month period ended December 31, 2025, net income was $4.3 million, or $.31 per diluted share, as compared to $4.7 million, or $.34 per diluted share, during the fourth quarter of 2024.
